Are you planning a Da Nang to Hoi An day trip in 2026? In this Vietnam travel vlog, I’m taking you on an epic half-day group tour to show you exactly how to plan your itinerary and what to expect along the way!

We kick off the day at the Son Tra Peninsula to see the spectacular Lady Buddha Da Nang—the tallest Buddha statue in Vietnam—before heading to the epic Marble Mountains. I'll show you what it's really like to explore the ancient cave temples, pagodas, and the traditional stone carving village. Finally, we end the tour wandering through the magical, lantern-lit streets of Hoi An Ancient Town.

Whether you are wondering how to get from Da Nang to Hoi An, if a guided half-day tour is worth the money, or how many stairs are actually at the Marble Mountains, this complete 2026 travel guide has everything you need to know.
